newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi '96 rice imports estimated at 700,000 tonnes.
newsitem.headline: Saudi '96 rice imports estimated at 700,000 tonnes.

text.p: Saudi Arabia is estimated to have imported 700,000 tonnes of rice in 1996 mostly from India, the United States, Thailand and Pakistan, a Saudi newspaper on Wednesday quoted importers as saying.

Al-Eqtisadiah quoted the sources as saying that there would be no surplus in rice stockpiles from the 1996 imports, unlike in 1994 when Saudi imported 720,000 tonnes which led to a surplus and a decline in 1995 imports to 470,000 tonnes.

Saudi Arabia, one of the biggest rice importers in the world, imported 50 percent of its rice from India in 1996, 25 percent from the United States, 17 percent from Thailand and eight percent from Pakistan, the paper said.
It valued the annual rice market in the kingdom at around three billion riyals ($800 million).
